result.summary: Found 1 visually broken issue: a major missing-image problem on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card.

issues.description: The restaurant image for 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' under 'Popular right now' has failed to load, showing a large light-grey placeholder box with a broken-image icon in the center instead of a food/restaurant photo.
issues.suggestion: Investigate and fix the image source/CDN URL for this restaurant, ensure the asset exists and loads correctly, and add a proper fallback image or retry logic so a broken-image placeholder is not shown to users.
